step.cmd: Determine if there is enough information to adjudicate the dismissal based on the National Policy on Levels of Decision :

ul.li: If additional details are needed, fact-find with the client or employer and go to step 5. fact-find
If additional details are not needed, go to step 7.

step.cmd: Determine if the client or employer was contacted during fact-finding:

ul.li: If the client or employer was not contacted or did not reply to the N-10-00-00 or Z-00-00-00 letter, go to Reassigning the issue to Level 2 . Reassigning the issue to Level 2
If the client or employer was contacted, go to step 6.

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Main Issue: Select Reason for separation .
Comments: Type “Dismissal — [employer’s name] — [last day worked] — [client or employer].”
Details: Document the fact-finding details according to Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
